Job Title: Senior Specialist, Program Management
Job Code: 45448
Job Location: Plano, TX – On Site
Job Schedule: 9/80 - Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off

L3Harris Technologies is an agile global aerospace and defense technology innovator, delivering end-to-end solutions that meet customers’ mission-critical needs. The company provides advanced defense and commercial technologies across space, air, land, sea and cyber domains. L3Harris has approximately $18 billion in annual revenue and 47,000 employees, with customers in more than 100 countries.

Job Description:

Directs all phases of program from inception through completion. Drives program execution to achieve key business and financial objectives for orders, revenue recognition, operating income, and free cash flow for new, continuing, or current programs. Responsible for the cost, schedule and technical performance of company programs or subsystems of major programs.
Participates in the negotiation of contract and contract changes. Coordinates the preparation of proposals, business plans, performance Statement of Work (SOW) and specifications, operating budgets and financial terms/conditions of contract. Acts as primary customer contact for program activities, leading program review sessions with each customer to discuss cost, schedule, and technical performance.
Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to master plans and schedules, identifies program problems and obtains solutions, such as allocating resources or changing contractual specifications. Directs the work of employees assigned to the program from technical, manufacturing and administrative areas.

Essential Functions:

- Candidates must have familiarity with program planning, earned value management (EVM), supply chain, risk management, quality control, production control, and product costing tools.
- Must demonstrate a keen understanding of basic business operations and the organizational levers (systems, processes, departments, functions) that drive profitable growth.
- The individual will work without appreciable direction and exercise considerable latitude to determine and develop approaches to solutions.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint) and MS Project are required.
- Experience running programs for Government and Government Prime contractors is required, and running avionics/electronics programs for airborne and/or space systems is desired
- PMP® certified or attainment within 2 years of hire
- Ability to travel up to 20%

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field and minimum 6 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.
- Active Secret U.S. security clearance

Preferred Additional Skills:

- Experience managing development programs with significant structured software development scope.
- Works under consultative direction against annual goals to manage large, complex project initiatives of strategic importance to the organization.
- Communicates within and outside of the organization to influence leadership to accept new practices, approaches, and concepts.

Job Description:
Directs all phases of programs from inception through completion. Drives program execution in order to achieve key business and financial objectives for orders, revenue recognition, operating income, and free cash flow for new, continuing, or current programs. Responsible for the cost, schedule and technical performance of company programs or subsystems of major programs. Participates in the negotiation of contract and contract changes. Coordinates the preparation of proposals, business plans, performance Statement of Work (SOW) and specifications, operating budgets and financial terms/conditions of contract. Acts as primary customer contact for program activities, leading program review sessions with customer to discuss cost, schedule, and technical performance. Establishes design concepts, criteria and engineering efforts for product research, development, integration and test. Expands the product line with the customer. Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to master plans and schedules, identifies program problems and obtains solutions, such as allocating resources or changing contractual specifications. Directs the work of employees assigned to the program from technical, manufacturing and administrative areas.

Essential Functions:
- Lead the development and implementation of a broad, coordinated set of plans and programs to meet the goals and priorities of the company. (in this capacity, may report directly to the Business Area Director).
- Conducts project baselines and identifies project metrics.
- Effectively communicate project expectations to project team members and stakeholders (including customers) in a timely and clear fashion.
- Provide expertise and consulting to project managers in the process of project management and in the softer skills of team dynamics, team building and group motivation.
- Ensures assigned projects are delivered within scope, schedule, budget and quality levels are consistent with partner/customer expectations.
- Promotes project scope growth and negotiates scope changes with the customers.  Manages project closure.
- Identify follow-on or related new project opportunities.
- Understand relationship between project and Company strategic objectives and maximize leveraging activities.
- Define and document project scope, goals and deliverables in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders
- Develop full-scale project plans and associated communication documents
- Draft and submit budget, and recommend subsequent budget changes where necessary
- Set and continually manage project expectations with customers, team members and other stakeholders.
- Identify and manage project/program dependencies and critical path including intra project dependencies.
- Plan and schedule program and project timelines and milestones using appropriate tools
- Develop and deliver progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation, and presentations
- Perform Risk Management and Mitigation in a pro-active fashion. Pro-actively manage Program risk reserves
- Review and approve all purchase orders, subcontracts as well as changes to the main contract documents.
- Perform lessons learned when required
- Accountable for maintaining the target Gross Margin
- Accountable for revenue and cash
- Provide mentoring, coaching and direction setting to team members and other project managers.
- Extensive amount of travel may be required to support proposal activity and project execution

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
- Ability to gain secret clearance
- 3-5 years experience with EVMS

Preferred Additional Skills:
- PMP Certification
- Excellent organizational and time management skills
- Strong project management skills including earn value management
- Solid background in electromechanical systems, optics, aerospace products or similar technologies
- Ability to coordinate activities inter-company and with multiple departments such as Engineering, Operations, Finance, Customer Service, etc.
- Ability to coordinate activities of major subcontractors or partner organizations
- Knowledge of contract terms and conditions and sub contract management
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Strong drive and resilience
- Action and result oriented
- Ability to build strong relationships with people at all levels. Ability to influence people at all levels
- A willingness to see things through to the end
- A team player who is comfortable working with other professionals
- Ability to work efficiently under pressure and to tight deadlines
- Being an inspirational leader who is able to demonstrate enthusiasm, passion
- Willingness to take on project ownership and accountability

The Director of Corporate Strategy is responsible for shaping the organization's long-term vision, driving growth through differentiated technologies and mission solutions, and ensuring alignment with Department of War (DoW) and international customer security priorities
- As a member of the Corporate Strategy team, this position plays an important role in shaping the strategic direction of the company, with a strong focus on supporting strategic growth initiatives
- Skilled in analytical methods, producing fact-based, logical hypothesis and scenarios with well-thought-out conclusions
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required, including the use of Microsoft-PowerPoint to convey analysis and recommendations to stakeholders and company executives

Maintains a keen awareness and acumen around disruptive technologies, emerging trends, innovation and competitors to leverage in creation of growth plans

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Business Development, Government Relations, Engineering, and Business Strategy to ensure strategic, technology and commercial roadmaps align with mission needs and warfighter requirements. Maintain strong working relationships with key personnel from each business segment/unit while efficiently managing project resources
- Executive Project Management: Manages regular and adhoc projects for the Executive team and Board, including strategic Planning, emerging trends and technologies, domestic and international markets, R&D, strategic and operational analyses, comparison studies, and other related work products
- Growth Initiatives: Assists with the development and implementation of corporate and business segment strategic growth initiatives
- Works effectively as a leader and contributing team member of the Corporate Strategy team

- Bachelor's Degree in Economics or Engineering  or other related quantitative field with 10 years prior experience, Graduate Degree with 8 years prior experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 19 years of prior related experience.

Preferred Additional Skills:

- MBA or MBA in process
- Professional Services/Consulting experience
- Aerospace and defense industry experience
- Excellent written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal communication skills
- Very strong (well above average) MS-Excel and MS-PowerPoint skills
- Results-oriented, takes the initiative mentality
- Demonstrates a highly analytical work ethic/approach
- A fast learner with the ability to take initial direction and self-manage to complete assignments on time and to expectations
- Highly collaborative team player
- Pragmatic with a strong analytical and problem-solving ability
- Ability to devise logical methods/approaches
- Strong project management skills, including demonstrated ability to think end-to-end and manage multiple priorities/projects simultaneously
- Strong financial acumen, proficiency in strategic frameworks (e.g., SWOT), and exceptional communication skills to influence C-suite and government executives.

As a subsidiary of L3Harris Technologies and within the Integrated Mission Systems Segment, the WESCAM division develops the most advanced optical sensor and targeting systems for global defense and military sectors, National Security, Search & Rescue and Airborne law enforcement agencies. From long-range covert surveillance missions to search and rescue operations, our MX-series systems, and the mission systems solutions they are a part of, produce stabilized high-magnification electro-optical and infrared images from airborne, marine and ground based platforms, enabling our customers to see first and act first.

About the Role
Directs all phases of programs from inception through completion. Drives program execution in order to achieve key business and financial objectives for orders, revenue recognition, operating income, and free cash flow for new, continuing, or current programs. Responsible for the cost, schedule and technical performance of company programs or subsystems of major programs. Participates in the negotiation of contract and contract changes. Coordinates the preparation of proposals, business plans, performance Statement of Work (SOW) and specifications, operating budgets and financial terms/conditions of contract. Acts as primary customer contact for program activities, leading program review sessions with customer to discuss cost, schedule, and technical performance. Establishes design concepts, criteria and engineering efforts for product research, development, integration and test. Expands the product line with the customer. Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to master plans and schedules, identifies program problems and obtains solutions, such as allocating resources or changing contractual specifications. Directs the work of employees assigned to the program from technical, manufacturing and administrative areas.

This position supports a Time & Materials (T&M) contract structure with multiple active performance obligations funded across government fiscal years and will transition to support follow-on fixed price contracts.  The O&A Program Manager will work closely with Engineering, Operations, and Manufacturing to ensure rapid identification, scoping, pricing, negotiation, execution, and closure of O&A work packages across all C-135 variants on site, including Rivet Joint, Cobra Ball, Combat Sent, Trainer, Constant Phoenix, and RCTB platforms.

This role offers strong growth potential within L3Harris's Engineering, Procurement, and Fabrication (EPF) program management portfolio, with opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement as the candidate develops expertise across the broader EPF mission areas.

Essential Functions:

- Manage O&A contract execution including cost, schedule, and technical performance across multiple concurrent active performance obligations
- Serve as the primary customer contact for O&A program activities, leading program reviews and communicating status to customers and leadership
- Coordinate with MITD/PDM team to identify, scope, and document discrepancies that fall outside the base SOW and require O&A coverage
- Drive aggressive closure of open discrepancy reports (DRs) and work tickets across Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Contracts to support billing and contract closeout
- Manage contract closeout activities, ensuring all deliverables, financial reconciliations, and administrative requirements are met to enable timely payment
- Develop and maintain accurate cost tracking, EACs, and ETCs across all active O&A performance obligations
- Leverage data analytics and advanced reporting tools to track open work items, monitor financial performance, and provide data-driven status visibility

- Travel as required (up to 5%)

- Experience with DoD contracts in an aerospace maintenance, modification, or depot environment
- Experience driving closure of open action items, work orders, or DRs in a deadline-driven environment

- Experience with Big Safari program management processes and contracting vehicles
- Familiarity with C-135 aircraft platforms and maintenance environments
- Knowledge of existing L3Harris processes, tools, and operations

- Excellent editing, writing, and verbal communication

L3Harris Technologies is an agile global aerospace and defense technology innovator, delivering end-to-end solutions that meet customers’ mission-critical needs. The company provides advanced defense and commercial technologies across space, air, land, sea and cyber domains. L3Harris has approximately $18 billion in annual revenue and 47,000 employees, with customers in more than 100 countries.
Job Description:
L3Harris Corporation is currently seeking a high-energy Program Manager to lead the growth and execution of Development programs within the Maritime Integrated Systems and Encryption (ISE) business. The PM will have a unique end-to-end life cycle management opportunity to leverage decades of L3Harris experience in C5ISR and Navigation & Machinery Control solutions to shape next generation solutions with customers, build a portfolio of new business, and own its profitability in execution.
The Program Manager oversees all efforts relating to contract execution and is responsible for planning, executing, and monitoring projects from beginning to end, according to strict deadlines and budgets. The Development Program Manager acts as the point-of-contact between elements of Program Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, Test, Quality, Engineering, Business Development and Finance. They ensure cost and schedule conformance on assigned projects by coordinating the procurement, build, and test of complex electronic systems. We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Program Manager to lead and support project execution while driving the implementation of Earned Value Management (EVM). This role will be responsible for ensuring program performance is accurately measured using EVM principles.
A successful candidate should be able to:
- Handle stressful situations with maturity, respect, and confidence
- Demonstrate strong interpersonal and relationship building skills
- Be a self-starter with a track record of identifying and implementing creative solutions to complex problems
- Demonstrate attention to detail with strong organizational skills
- Excel in a team environment with the ability to avoid and resolve conflict
- Interpret basic engineering instructions and drawings
- Understand various manufacturing processes and methods

Essential Functions:
- Work collaboratively with and act as primary point of contact for Customer stakeholders for each assigned L3Harris subsystem.
- Responsible for managing programs within a matrixed organization, communicating with stakeholders internal and external to the organization.
- Communicates within and outside of own function to gain cooperation on operational processes, practices, and procedures.
- Manage cost, schedule and technical performance on multiple, parallel development, production and qualification efforts.
- Develop and monitor financial forecasts for monthly, quarterly and annual reviews

- Implement EVM processes across projects to track cost, schedule, and performance metrics.
- Develop and maintain EVM baselines, including Planned Value (PV), Earned Value (EV), and Actual Cost (AC).
- Perform lead-time and critical path analysis on multi-level designs and hardware builds
- Oversee program budgets with the responsibility to analyze, manage and report on budget performance and variance analysis
- Coordinate with Master Schedulers and Master Planners to develop baseline program plans
- Coordinate resource requirements (Staffing) with subsystem Program Managers and work with functional leadership to assure that issues are addressed in a timely manner
- With functional leader support, develop the Work Breakdown Structure, project schedules, resource plans, and risk management strategies.
- Responsible for process improvement, drawing on best practices and lessons identified.
- Works alongside operations, supply chain, and engineering at various levels to complete projects and processes.
- Utilize program management tools to monitor and report program performance to objectives (including budget, schedule, and other management requirements) and facilitate program coordination and decision-making.
- Able to travel up to 10%

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience
- Experience with Cost-Plus and Fixed Price contracts and major subcontracts.
- Expert EVMS knowledge demonstrated on successful production programs.
- Demonstrated ability to lead Proposal Development and Capture efforts
- Ability to obtain a US Secret Security Clearance
- Project Management Institute (PMI) Program Management Professional (PMP) Certification or working towards certification

Preferred Additional Skills:
- Related experience in a manufacturing, production, or other highly schedule-based environment
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and ability to analyze data using graphs and pivot tables
- Experience using schedule management tools such as Microsoft project
- Proficient in SAP, MS Office, MS Project, Cobra
- Demonstrated ability in financial or data analysis and monitoring is desired
- Experience in cost control, budgeting, and forecasting.
- Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional environment, facilitating collaboration between engineering, QA, and test site teams.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels

L3Harris Technologies is seeking a motivated Program Management Specialist to support the Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) program supporting the MIDS-JTRS (Multifunctional Information Distribution System – Joint Tactical Radio System) terminal family. Reporting to and assisting the Senior MRO Program Manager, this position helps coordinate the cost, schedule, and technical performance of MIDS-JTRS repair, overhaul, and sustainment activities, supporting efforts to keep the fielded warfighter and international partner fleets at high levels of operational readiness.

The Program Management Specialist will assist in daily coordination with the MIDS Program Office (International Program Office/IPO), the U.S. Navy, U.S. Air Force, and a global community of allied and coalition customers to help plan, execute, and improve repair turnaround times, depot throughput, spares availability, and obsolescence management strategies. This role supports the Senior PM in balancing L3Harris Operations demands and capacity with customer repair requirements, helping to track and prioritize induction and turnaround schedules. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong communication, organizational, and teamwork skills, and a willingness to develop the relationship-building and cross-cultural awareness needed to support an international customer base.

Essential Functions:
- Supports the Senior MRO Program Manager across all phases of the MIDS-JTRS MRO program, from receipt of assets through repair, test, and return-to-customer delivery.
- Assists in tracking cost, schedule, and technical performance for the MRO program, contributing to the achievement of orders, revenue recognition, operating income, and free cash flow commitments.

- Serves as a supporting interface with the MIDS Program Office, U.S. Navy/Air Force stakeholders, and international customers on matters related to repair status, turnaround time (TAT), depot capacity, and fleet readiness.

- Assists in the preparation and coordination of program review sessions (PMRs), Integrated Baseline Reviews, and customer working groups.

- Supports repair induction planning, prioritization, and throughput tracking to help meet operational availability requirements across a globally dispersed customer base.

- Assists with obsolescence and diminishing manufacturing sources (DMS) initiatives to help sustain long-term repair capability for legacy and current MIDS terminal configurations.

- Supports the preparation of proposals, repair pricing, statements of work (SOW), and terms and conditions for MRO contracts, task orders, and FMS cases.

- Participates in support of contract negotiations, contract modifications, and repair/overhaul pricing agreements.

- Coordinates with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Depot Operations to help resolve technical issues and track root-cause failure trends and repeat-repair discrepancies.

- Helps establish and monitor program milestones, repair throughput goals, and material readiness plans; assists in identifying risks and implementing corrective actions.

- Assists in coordinating the work of program personnel across technical, manufacturing/depot, and administrative areas assigned to the MRO program.

- Supports growth of the MRO program scope, including expanding repair capability, new customer onboarding, and additional terminal variants.

- Assists in preparing status updates and briefings for site and business unit leadership.

- Performs other duties as assigned.

- This position may require up to 10% travel for customer meetings, program reviews, and coordination activities.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree with 6 years minimum experience, or Master's degree with minimum 4 years' experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum 10 years prior related experience.

- Familiarity with the MIDS Program Office (International Program Office) structure, processes, and stakeholders.
- Exposure to obsolescence management and DMS mitigation for legacy electronic systems.

Job Location: Camden, NJ
Job Schedule: 9/80
Job Description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing diverse, high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.
About L3Harris Technologies:
L3Harris Technologies is an agile global aerospace and defense technology innovator, delivering end-to-end solutions that meet customers’ mission-critical needs. The company provides advanced defense and commercial technologies across space, air, land, sea and cyber domains. L3Harris has approximately $18 billion in annual revenue and 47,000 employees, with customers in more than 100 countries.
Job Description:
L3Harris Corporation is currently seeking a high-energy Program Manager to lead the growth and execution of Production programs within the Maritime Integrated Systems and Encryption (ISE) business. The PM will have a unique end-to-end life cycle management opportunity to leverage decades of L3Harris experience in C5ISR and Navigation & Machinery Control solutions to shape next generation solutions with customers, build a portfolio of new business, and own its profitability in execution.
The Program Manager oversees all efforts relating to contract execution and is responsible for planning, executing, and monitoring projects from beginning to end, according to strict deadlines and budgets. The Production Program Manager acts as the point-of-contact between elements of Program Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, Test, Quality, Engineering, Business Development and Finance. They ensure cost and schedule conformance on assigned projects by coordinating the procurement, build, and test of complex electronic systems. We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Program Leader to lead and support project execution while driving the implementation of Earned Value Management (EVM). This role will be responsible for ensuring program performance is accurately measured using EVM principles.
A successful candidate should be able to:
- Lead Team of experienced program managers and IPTs across multiple sites.
- Handle stressful situations with maturity, respect, and confidence
- Demonstrate strong interpersonal and relationship building skills
- Be a self-starter with a track record of identifying and implementing creative solutions to complex problems
- Demonstrate attention to detail with strong organizational skills
- Excel in a team environment with the ability to avoid and resolve conflict
- Interpret basic engineering instructions and drawings
- Understand various manufacturing processes and methods

Essential Functions:
- Work collaboratively with and act as primary point of contact for Customer stakeholders for each assigned L3Harris subsystem.
- Responsible for managing programs within a matrixed organization, communicating with stakeholders internal and external to the organization.
- Communicates within and outside of own function to gain cooperation on operational processes, practices, and procedures.
- Manage cost, schedule and technical performance on multiple, parallel development, production and qualification efforts.

The Operations Organization is seeking an Operations Program Manager who is creative and loves to solve the tough problems that arise throughout the development and manufacturing phases of our programs.  This is a high visibility role that is responsible for all aspects of build activities in a high mix, low volume manufacturing environment.  Leadership skills are essential in this position, as you will lead and coordinate all operations activities throughout the product development lifecycle, from conceptualization/design through manufacturing and shipment. You will lead a cross functional team across all disciplines of operations and some design engineering disciplines in the planning of manufacturing readiness, risk management, and execution of the design, build and test spaceflight hardware, working directly with a wide variety of people, including technicians and engineers, to supervise and troubleshoot cutting edge opto-mechanical assemblies.

Essential Functions:

- Provide direction to all operational functions in the support of the assembly and integration of a variety of opto-mechanical and electrical assemblies
- As an integrated leader of the program team, provide status to program managers on cost, schedule and delivery of the operational disciplines.
- Team with Integrated Product Team leaders to ensure that all plans align and are achievable.
- Estimate and track operational costs, initiate Continuous Improvement activities to reduce waste in the manufacturing and production processes.
- Create strategies to incorporate DFMAT, APQP, and Lean manufacturing starting at the design of hardware through build and delivery.
- Support design engineering, analysis, program management and IPT leads, process development, and proposal activities.
- Create and deliver presentations for Peer Reviews, Manufacturing Readiness Reviews, internal management reviews, and customer reviews.
- Provide capacity planning and lab space layout support for new programs.
- Be a technical leader, advisor, and mentor.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 6 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.

- Ability to obtain secret clearance.

- Knowledge of program and project management techniques and tools.
- Evidence of strong problem-solving capability, people skills, and the ability to conduct presentations for various internal/external customers.
- Prior experience leading teams or programs in a production environment.
- Manufacturing engineering, supply chain management, or other operational experience.
- Experience with complex electro-mechanical and optical assemblies.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.
Job Title: Principal, Supply Chain Program Management
Job Code: 42740
Job Location: Fort Wayne, IN
Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off

Job Description:
Do you have what it takes to lead L3Harris Space Systems programs into the next era of space systems satellite programs? Are you interested in competing and winning new business opportunities related to space? Do you have what it takes to execute a fixed price development program that is literally changing the game in responsive space? If so, L3Harris Space Systems is seeking a Supply Chain Program Manager for the ISR Space business to capture and execute responsive space programs. Overall responsibilities include working with the customer and leading the internal and supplier teams in capturing and executing space programs and/or studies with emphasis on technology development and mission solutions including:

Essential Functions:
- Responsible for leading Space and Airborne Systems supply chain program management in partnership with Engineering, Program Management, and Operations to drive execution, alignment with commodity strategies, supply base optimization, and lowest total acquisition cost on a key Program.
- Able to use hands-on, cross-functional approaches to identify pain points and drive improvements.  Must have the passion, business acumen and experience to drive best-in-class supply chain processes and efficiencies
- Work with the assigned functional and program leaders to track and coordinate all program deliverables, highlighting key program risks and putting plans in place to mitigate those risks, providing regular reports/updates on program status, including identification and mitigation of long-term supply chain risks
- Manage the flow of critical milestones and project requirements including analysis of supplier capacity and capability. Will ensure supplier ability to supply parts with on-going adjustment of material flow for adequate line fill and inventory optimization
- Provide technical support for DFx (design for all desirable manufacturability, assembly, test attributes) including reviewing engineering changes and assessment of materials/supply chain impact
- Active engagement in process improvements to continually increase efficiency and effectiveness of product development and supply chain processes
- Manage supplier relationships and supplier performance to achieve program and customer requirements
- Interacts with suppliers to ensure appropriate support and execution of deliverables as well as participate in managing supplier relationships and performance
- Interface and influence a diverse team comprised of L3Harris engineering and supply chain, and supplier teammates
- Develop, drive, and track supply chain management metrics customized to space programs
- Responsible for high-level relationship management, evolve as recognized thought leader/trusted partner
- Ability to obtain Secret clearance.

Qualifications:
- Requires mastery level knowledge within a specific technical area or multiple job areas. Viewed as an expert and/or resource within the field by peers in and outside the organization. Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 12 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 10 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 16 years of prior related experience.

Preferred Additional Skills:
- Secret clearance preferred
- Experience in the following contract types:  FFP, FPIF, T&M, Labor Hour, Cost Reimbursement (w/fixed-fee, incentive fee or award fee)
- Experience as Cost Account Manager for Subcontracts managing budgets and sales forecasting
- Proficient in Microsoft Suite of Products
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Ability to periodically travel to supplier facilities (mainly domestic locations)

Job Code:  45174
Job Location:  Salt Lake City, UT.
Schedule:  9/80- Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked, and have every other Friday off

Job Description:
The Supply Chain Program Manager (SCPM) , for Acoustics Systems in Salt Lake City, UT will leverage extensive experience in Supply Chain and/or Program or Product Management to lead a cross functional team to across complex IAS Programs/Products. In collaboration with functional leaders, the SCPM will institute tailored “right sized” practices and approaches for successful execution across the full product lifecycle, with a  strong focus on risk and opportunity management, MRO/production materials management, raw materials, and obsolescence mitigation. The SCPM will be responsible for program cost, schedule and compliance with internal and external regulations with respect to materials and subcontracts.
In this highly visible role, the SCPM will collaborate across functions and be part of the Supply Chain team serving as a key interface to Program and Product Offices, Engineering, Quality, Finance and Operations. This individual will also be a Subject Matter Expert in Supply Chain and Programmatic Practices.
Essential Functions:
- Serve as the primary liaison between Supply Chain and other functions for key Products/Programs
- Develop and execute Supply Chain strategies and actions to support full Program lifecycle
- Ensure timely completion of all material and subcontract program milestones
- As the Program’s Material and Subcontracts Cost Account Manager (CAM), be accountable for the material and subcontract program budgets, and drive actions to improve financial performance
- Analyze key performance indicators and identify challenged areas and champion continued improvements
- Lead others by influence in a matrixed environment
- Develop and Manage Supply Chain Risks & Opportunities
- Support compliance with all internal policies and external laws and regulations
- Own the Supply Chain portion and be accountable to Program Finance in rolling up quarterly financial status against the AOP and Short Term Forecast, EAC and ETC
- Work with Supply Chain team to develop and support the strategic supplier relationships
- Coordinate and align supplier strategy with Category Management
- Develop Supply Chain Recovery and communicate critical issues to stakeholders with solution focused actions
- Responsible for all Supply Chain inputs in support of all proposal activities
- Coordinate Subcontracts involvement with requirements development
- Proven ability to break large complex issues into smaller individual approaches to achieve business objectives
- Ability to communicate effectively, to internal executive leadership or line management both written and verbally

- Ability to obtain a US Secret security clearance

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience.  In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
- Experience in Supply Chain and Program Management execution across a Product Life Cycle (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, PRR etc.)
- Experience with New Business Proposals / Capture Experience on competitive and/or sole source pursuits
- Experience in Subcontractor Management through various stages of development through production
- 4-8 years’ experience and expert level knowledge in FAR, DFARS, ITAR

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Aerospace and Defense MRO / R&R / Depot materials management
- Experience in developing technical statements of work
- PMP Certification

Job Title: Program Finance Manager
Job Code: 42342
Job Location: Palm Bay, FL
Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off

Job Description:

The Manager, Program Finance is responsible for directing the financial control of large and/or complex programs. Works as a key business partner to Program Managers and functional teams to establish and maintain the program’s financial plan, perform analyses, and prepare reports in order to ensure that contracts are within negotiated and agreed-upon parameters and government cost control guidelines. Lead a team of 3 individuals to perform full earned value management with full customer reporting on a Cost Plus Award Fee Fixed Fee contract. Performs financial analyses such as funding profiles, sales outlook, and variance analysis. Conducts detailed financial analysis that provide insight into cost and schedule health on a program to ensure financial objectives are met. Interprets performance data on a weekly and monthly basis with the goal of providing early indicators of program health. Monitors program adherence to approved budget. Responsible for monthly financial forecasting and long-range planning of their respective programs, focusing on Orders, Revenue, Profit and Cash Flow.
Essential Functions:
- Works under general oversight to develop time-phased integrated budgets and schedules, Earned Value (EV) data compliance and reporting, cost accounting and cost and schedule integration.
- Comprehensive knowledge for financial performance of their programs, providing management with an early warning of potential performance issues, identifying risks and offering solutions.
- Budgeting, cost control and variance analysis, internal/external reporting, risk management and financial support.
- Development of quarterly EACs; analyze/assist in accurate projection of Estimate to Complete (ETC), Estimate at Complete (EAC) and Latest Revised Estimate (LRE) data.
- Educate and lead financial analysts with organization of Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), creation and maintenance of charge numbers.
- Analyze costs and personnel ensuring that actuals are within budget and charged to the correct end objective.
- Analyze workforce planning, forecasting and reporting.
- Accounting data extraction and reconciliation.
- Generate program financial artifacts such as EV reports, graphs, and analysis, as required to include customer reporting.
- Develop and present briefing of program financial status to customer.
- Educate PMO and CAMS with internal reports on cost and schedule performance.
- Communicates within and outside the organization to explain and influence changes to practices and processes.
- Provides suggestions and implementation of new process improvement initiatives.
- Perform ad-hoc analysis, data integrity checks, and validations related to program financials.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.

Preferred Additional Skills:
- Experience with Program Finance
- Experience with EVMS including COBRA
- Experience with IPM DAR or CPR 1-7
- Experience with people management

Job Title: Director, Operations Management
Job Code: 44994
Job Location: Carlstadt, NJ
Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days- totaling 80 hours worked- and have every other Friday off

Job Description:
ARDE Inc., a subsidiary of L3Harris Technologies and formerly Aerojet Rocketdyne, located in Carlstadt, New Jersey, is seeking an experienced, driven leader to serve as Director of Operations, reporting directly to the Site General Manager.
The Director of Operations will be responsible for leading day-to-day business operations and overseeing manufacturing execution across the site. ARDE is an industry leader in the design and manufacture of high-performance pressure vessels for the space and defense markets, producing fracture-critical and mission-critical hardware for a broad range of domestic and international customers. Our products are subject to both EAR and ITAR controls.
ARDE is experiencing strong year-over-year growth, supported by a robust backlog and expanding demand across both established and emerging markets. The business is built on long-standing customer relationships with major prime contractors in the space and defense sectors, while also continuing to grow strategic partnerships with innovative companies in the emerging commercial space market. This momentum is further strengthened by multiple new program starts currently in design and development, several of which are expected to transition into substantial multi-year production following certification.
Our success is grounded in a commitment to delivering high-quality products on time and at a fair price. ARDE maintains deep technical and manufacturing expertise in the design and production of core products, including high-pressure Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels and propellant tanks utilizing a broad range of metallic and non-metallic materials. The organization is also recognized for its capabilities in structural and dynamics analysis, fracture mechanics, materials and process engineering, metal forming, welding, and non-destructive inspection, supported by rigorous program management and systems engineering discipline.
Essential Functions:
·      Provide clear and consistent leadership that helps individuals understand their roles, strengthens teamwork, and builds a culture of accountability and execution
·        Manages all aspects of the site operations with direct responsibility for Manufacturing, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, facility maintenance, planning, purchasing, EH&S, and Security.
·        Drives achievement of organizational objectives including financial performance, on-time delivery, cost of poor quality and safety performance.
·        Develops and execute staffing plan to support current and future program.
·        Strategic planning/management of raw material inventory to ensure competitive lead-time for new business, including efforts with parent company Global Trade Compliance of highly controlled material.
·        Management of site wide capital plan and execution.
·        Oversight of Continuous Improvement (CI) on manufacturing and test through rigorous application of CI tools to reduce cost and lead times.
·        In collaboration with Human Resources, mange union collective bargaining agreement and participate in contract negotiations.
·        Drives EH&S excellence and safety culture.
·        Collaborates with direct report managers to provide technical direction and leadership to manufacturing and quality engineering.
·        Leads Business Resilience Team to ensure that the site is prepared to handle and continue operations if an event impacts operations.
Qualifications:
·        Bachelor’s Degree with a minimum of 15 years of prior related experience. Graduate Degree with a minimum of 13 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 19 years of prior related experience.

Preferred Additional Skills:
·        Advanced business knowledge, general management and leadership capability to lead business area or functional teams
·        Broad experience across multiple related professional disciplines within the organization, combining theory, past practical experience and the organization’s business practices.
·        Previous Aerospace experience
·        Previous experience with EAR and ITAR

Job Title: Lead, Supply Chain Program Manager – Power Systems
Job Location: Camden, NJ
Job Schedule: 9/80 Regular
Job Description:
The Supply Chain Program Manager (SCPM) is the single supply chain owner for program in the Maritime Power Systems portfolio in Camden, NJ, accountable for material cost, schedule, and risk from proposal through contract closeout. This is a Control Account Manager role at its core. The SCPM will own the material EAC, brief performance to program and executive leadership, and drive supplier execution against a baseline you set and defend. Working as one supply chain, you will bring Procurement, Finance, Engineering, Quality, Operations, and Program office around a single material strategy, turning program goals into results the customer can count on. This is a role for someone that wants to own the outcome, not just report on it.
Essential Functions:
•             Serve as Control Account Manager for material scope, owning the time-phased budget baseline, BCRs, Latest Revised Estimate (LRE), Estimate At Completion (EAC), material forecast, annual operating plan (AOP), and presenting variance analysis and recovery plans at CAM and program reviews.
•             Build and execute the program’s material forecast, tying material receipts to revenue recognition and defending the forecast by managing risks and opportunities.
•             Develop supplier recovery plans and communicate critical issues to stakeholders with solution focused actions and recommendations
•             Develop the Supply Chain Management Plan for each assigned project and integrate it into the master Program Management plan across cost, schedule, and delivery.
•             Partner with Procurement on sourcing strategy, negotiations, and purchase order execution, operating as one supply chain team against shared program objectives.
•             Manage supplier performance end to end, including risk and opportunity plans, corrective action, and escalation, Return-To-Green plan, holding suppliers to on-time delivery and quality commitments.
•             Own compliance flow-down to the supply base for FAR, DFARS, and ITAR requirements, and ensure procurement actions withstand DCMA and internal audit.
•             Analyze key performance indicators and identify challenged areas to drive cross-functional resolution of material shortages, nonconformances, and line-stop risks.
•             Responsible for leading all proposal supply chain elements, generating compliant material estimates, sourcing strategy, Basis of Estimates (BOE), risks and opportunities, gate presentations and material cost targets that shape a competitive bid.
•             Partner with strategic sourcing on long-term material strategy for the portfolio, including Long Term Agreements (LTA), supplier consolidation, second-source qualification, and sole-source risk reduction.
Qualifications:
•             Must be a U.S. Citizen
•             Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 9 years of relevant supply chain, program management, or finance experience; or a Master’s degree and a minimum of 7 years. Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
•             Demonstrated Control Account Manager experience, including proposals, material forecast, AOP, EVMS baseline management, variance analysis, and EAC development.
•             Working knowledge of Earned Value Management Systems and cost/schedule integration, with the ability to obtain the L3Harris CAM certification within 6 months of hire if not already held.
•             Hands-on experience in an ERP environment (SAP, Oracle, Costpoint, or equivalent) managing material planning and receipts.
•             Ability to communicate effectively with internal executive leadership and line management both written and verbally
•             New Business Proposals / Capture Experience on competitive and/or sole source pursuits
•             Advanced knowledge in FAR, DFARS, and ITAR as applied to subcontract and material management.
Preferred Additional Skills:
•             Active EVMS Level 1 and 2 certification or equivalent CAM credential at time of hire.
•             APICS/ASCM CPIM or CSCP certification, or PMP.
•             Experience leading material or subcontract recovery on a DX or DO rated order under production pressure.
•             Track record briefing material EAC and forecast performance directly to a VP/GM or external customer.
•             Experience executing sole-source supplier transitions or second-source qualifications on long-lead defense hardware.
•             Six Sigma or Lean certification (Green Belt or above)

Job Title: Specialist, Systems Engineer – Integrated Protection Strategy Analyst
Job Code: 45252
Job Location: Springfield, Virginia
Job Schedule: 5/8 – Monday-Friday

Job Description:
L3Harris has an opening for an Integrated Protection Strategy Analyst in Springfield, VA to join a dynamic team supporting critical national space mission operations. Our team is tight-knit, collaborative, and mission focused. We are regularly asked to develop operational solutions to meet unique and evolving mission objectives across a complex operational environment. The team supports integrated mission protection, enterprise operations synchronization, threat-informed mission assurance, and operational planning for high-priority space mission systems.
This role supports mission protection activities spanning launch, on-orbit, re-entry, and contingency operations. Responsibilities include monitoring mission systems and operational hazards, supporting conjunction and collision avoidance analysis, assessing threats to mission systems, supporting spectrum protection and interference mitigation activities, contributing to anomaly response, and helping develop procedures, checklists, training materials, and decision-support products. The position also supports the policy and governance aspects of integrated protection efforts by helping translate customer guidance, mission directives, operational policies, and enterprise protection frameworks into executable plans, procedures, concepts, and operational response options.
The selected candidate will coordinate with multiple internal and external stakeholders to maintain operational awareness, support readiness activities, contribute to mission protection planning, and improve mission protection effectiveness across the enterprise. We are looking for candidates who lean forward to not only identify issues, but also work with the team to propose solutions and implement improvements. Ability to thrive in a dynamic and ever-changing work environment is preferred. In addition to the required experience below, our ideal candidate needs to demonstrate exceptional personal initiative, strong analytical rigor, effective communication skills, and the ability to maintain composure and a good attitude in a demanding operational environment.

Essential Functions:
•    Help translate mission policy, operational guidance, enterprise directives, and protection frameworks into executable procedures, operational plans, and response actions.
•    Support integrated mission protection and enterprise operations synchronization for assigned mission systems.
•    Monitor mission systems, operational status, hazards, and threat activity to identify risks and mission impacts.
•    Perform operational analysis in support of conjunction and collision avoidance, mission assurance, anomaly response, operational risk assessment, and contingency operations.
•    Support spectrum protection, RF interference analysis, and deconfliction activities as required.
•    Support launch, on-orbit, re-entry, and contingency operations, including development and execution of procedures, checklists, and operational timelines.
•    Assist in the preparation and maintenance of operational products including briefings, status reports, mission assessments, and decision-support materials.
•    Support development and refinement of tactics, techniques, procedures, concepts of operations, checklists, and training materials.
•    Assist with mission protection planning, operational plan development, readiness events, and exercise support.
•    Support evaluation of courses of action, mission protection concepts, and operational recommendations for alignment with customer guidance, mission objectives, and protection priorities.
•    Integrate threat reporting, operational reporting, and system status information into mission impact assessments and mitigation recommendations.

Qualifications:
•    Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
•    Active Top-Secret/SCI clearance with CI Poly required.
•    Experience supporting mission protection, integrated protection strategy, space protection, or other threat-informed operations in space or national security environments.
•    Ability to translate mission guidance, doctrine, policy, and operational direction into executable mission protection actions, response options, and operational recommendations aligned with mission objectives and protection priorities.

Preferred Additional Skills:
•    Experience working on operations teams in a national security space, satellite operations, mission management, operations integration, or policy/planning environment.
•    Experience monitoring and assessing hazards, threats, and impacts to mission systems.
•    Experience with conjunction assessment, collision avoidance, orbital state data, and associated tools such as STK, MATLAB, FreeFlyer, or similar.
•    Experience supporting launch, early orbit, on-orbit, re-entry, or contingency operations.
•    Experience developing procedures, checklists, TTPs, CONOPS, operational plans, policy implementation guidance, training materials, or operational briefings.
•    Experience supporting exercises, readiness events, continuity activities, or operational rehearsals.
•    Experience with software languages for scripting, modeling, simulations, and data transfers including Python and PERL.
•    Experience with Microsoft Office suite programs, MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Job Description:

L3Harris is seeking a highly skilled Lead, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to join the Spectrum Superiority (S2) Sector team in Salt Lake City, UT. This analyst will play a key role in supporting financial performance management through accurate reporting, forecasting, and analytical insights. This role is responsible for income statement reconciliation, P&L analysis, segment reporting deliverables, and data integrity support across key financial systems. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical capability, attention to detail, and the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

Essential Functions:

·       Perform reconciliations of Revenue, Cost of Sales, and Operating Income within the income statement, including preparation of topside adjustments, element of cost analysis, and disaggregation reporting.
·       Support Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and JSP forecasting processes by preparing, updating, and validating forecast data and related financial inputs.
·       Prepare P&L fluctuation reports and analyze period-over-period variances to identify key business drivers and provide actionable insights.
·       Manage segment reporting requirements, including:
o    Business Interruption analysis
o    Domestic Casualty reporting
o    Annual Tax questionnaire support
o    End User Reporting
o    Investor Relations reporting
o    IDWA forecast updates
·       Prepare and maintain Working Capital reporting to support financial performance tracking and analysis.
·       Support BPC data integrity through validation activities, process improvements, and system testing.
·       Respond to ad hoc reporting requests by gathering, analyzing, and presenting financial data as needed.
·       Strong understanding of financial statements, forecasting processes, and variance analysis
·       Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data
·       Excellent communication and collaboration skills
·       Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

Job Code: 45809
Job Location: Schriever Space Force Base, Colorado
Job Schedule: 5/8 Monday-Friday

Job Description:
The Tie Dye program is seeking highly skilled and motivated Systems Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a background in orbital mechanics, space systems, space operations, integration & test experience and team management.
The Lead Systems Engineer provides advanced technical leadership in space operations including tactics development, planning, exercises, and lifecycle support of complex systems with an emphasis on protecting and defending space assets. This role applies space operations principles across the space enterprise including partners from the IC.
The engineer works independently on complex assignments, leads cross-functional technical efforts, and supports program execution from concept development through production and sustainment. The position requires strong collaboration with hardware, software, mechanical, test, quality, and management of teams to ensure the delivered solution meets performance, cost, schedule, and compliance requirements.

Essential Functions:
•    Work full time at a customer site in Colorado Springs.
•    Coordinate with geographically separated operators, creating synergy between various commands and organizations.
•    Certify as BSA-N crew member and periodically work crew shifts that may include holidays, nights, and weekends.
•    Partner with members of the IC in support of the Protect and Defend mission.
•    Support the development of CONOPS, procedures and the operational checkout of new systems and applications.
•    Participate in customer planning, technical exchange, and coordination meetings, as well as Engineering Review Boards.
•    Support the PMO with technical inputs on contract performance.
•    Participate in and provide site specific information for the project readiness review cycle, develop and conduct design reviews, and provide implementation coordination with affected users.

Qualifications:
•    Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience.  Graduate degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience.  In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
•    Active Top Secret clearance with Sensitive Compartmented Information  and an in-scope fully adjudicated Counterintelligence Polygraph.

Preferred Additional Skills:
•    STK Certification and/or Astrogator knowledge.
•    Familiarity with DoD/NRO spacecraft and missions.
•    Prior experience supporting Joint Operations including Joint Pubs 3-14 & 5.0.
•    Prior space operations lead responsibilities.
•    Knowledge of SAP/STO mission areas.
•    Space Domain Awareness experience.
•    Prior support to Tier-1 military exercises.
•    Experience applying systems engineering processes across the product lifecycle.
•    Experience working in cross-functional engineering teams on complex technical programs.
•    Ability to analyze and resolve complex technical issues with limited oversight.
•    Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
